'''November 1999 Portsmouth tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Portsmouth, UK on 7 November 1999. [[Mat Allen]] won it. It is known from Mike Kessling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d107">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-13-uk-portsmouth-11-7-99d107/ uk-portsmouth-11-7-99], DeckTech (Michael "Troop1023" Kessling, 13 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-13-uk-portsmouth-11-7-99d107/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 November 1999
* '''Site:''' Portsmouth, UK
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Mat Allen]]
